q: A person whom you do not know or have never met before is called a ____. (P1)
explain: Children should never accept gifts, rides, or food from strangers.

q: If an unknown stranger offers you sweets, money, or a car ride, you should ____. (P1)
options: say NO loudly, run away, and tell a trusted adult
explain: Never accept gifts or rides from strangers.

q: The private parts of your body covered by a swimming suit must NOT be touched by ____. (P1)
options: anyone, except a doctor with parents present
explain: Body boundaries teach children personal safety and protection from abuse.

q: If anyone touches you in an uncomfortable or unsafe way, you should ____. (P1)
options: shout, run away, and report immediately to parents or teachers
explain: Never keep unsafe secrets; always tell trusted guardians.
hint: Action when personal boundary is crossed.

q: Crime awareness (P1): What is Assault?
options: unlawfully using physical force or threatening violence against another person's body
